name: Kitahara Haruki
source:
The protagonist of White Album 2. 

Third-year student at Houjou High School where he is a model student and the rhythm guitarist of the Light Music Club. A well-meaning busybody with a strong sense of responsibility, he's always eager to helps others to the point of intrusiveness but has tendencies to disregard his own well-being while doing so.
